description: RECORDS a refund against a transaction — this WRITES a live tax/compliance record (adjusts tax owed). Use type="full" to refund the whole transaction, or type="partial" with line_items (each keyed by reference_product_id) for a partial refund. Numeral: POST /tax/refunds.

line_items.description: Required for type="partial": the line items to refund.

reference_product_id.description: Product id to apply the refund against (matches the original transaction line item).

sales_amount_refunded.description: Sale amount refunded for this line, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).

refund_processed_at.description: Unix timestamp (SECONDS) the refund was made. Defaults to now if omitted.

type.description: "full" refunds the whole transaction; "partial" requires line_items.

name: numeral_create_refund
title: Create refund
